name: OzFx
summary: OzFx is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers combined with oscillator filters to identify and ride market trends. It enters long positions when fast MA crosses above slow MA with confirming oscillator signals, and short positions on the reverse. The EA includes trailing stop functionality and risk management parameters to protect profits during trending moves.
summary_zh: OzFx是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用移动平均线交叉结合振荡器过滤来识别并跟随市场趋势。当快速MA上穿慢速MA且振荡器信号确认时做多，反之时做空。该EA包含移动止损功能和风险管理参数，以在趋势运行中保护利润。
strategy_analysis: OzFx策略的核心概念是基于移动平均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向，并结合振荡器（如RSI或MACD）作为入场过滤条件，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。入场条件为快速均线穿越慢速均线，同时振荡器处于超买或超卖区域之外确认趋势强度。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损设置以及移动止损跟踪机制，当价格向有利方向移动时逐步锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，允许用户自定义每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面，该EA提供最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损控制参数，但缺少马丁格尔或网格等激进策略，整体偏向稳健的趋势跟踪风格。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the OzFx strategy is based on moving average crossovers (golden cross and death cross) to determine trend direction, combined with oscillator filters (such as RSI or MACD) as entry confirmation to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets. Entry conditions require the fast moving average to cross the slow moving average while the oscillator confirms trend strength by staying outside overbought or oversold zones. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss settings along with a trailing stop mechanism that gradually locks in profits as price moves favorably. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and percentage-based calculation derived from account balance, allowing users to customize risk exposure per trade. Money management features include maximum position limits and daily maximum loss control parameters, but the EA lacks aggressive strategies like martingale or grid, leaning towards a conservative trend-following style overall.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰易懂，基于经典的均线交叉系统，适合趋势行情
内置振荡器过滤机制，有效减少震荡行情中的假信号和亏损交易
具备移动止损功能，能在趋势行情中有效锁定浮动利润
提供最大持仓和每日最大亏损控制，具备基本的风险管理框架
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期优化参数组合
pros_en: Clear and understandable strategy logic based on classic MA crossover system, suitable for trending markets
Built-in oscillator filter mechanism effectively reduces false signals and losing trades in ranging markets
Trailing stop functionality effectively locks in floating profits during trending moves
Provides maximum position and daily maximum loss controls with a basic risk management framework
High parameter adjustability allows users to optimize parameter combinations for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 均线交叉系统具有 inherent lag，入场信号延迟导致错过趋势初段利润
在震荡行情中仍可能产生连续亏损信号，振荡器过滤不能完全避免
缺少加仓和减仓机制，无法在趋势确认后增加仓位放大收益
止损和止盈为固定点数设置，未考虑ATR等波动性指标进行动态调整
未检测新K线形成，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
cons_en: MA crossover system has inherent lag, causing delayed entry signals that miss profits at the start of trends
Can still generate consecutive losing signals in ranging markets, as oscillator filtering cannot completely avoid this
Lacks position scaling mechanisms, unable to add positions after trend confirmation to amplify returns
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed pip settings without considering dynamic adjustment via ATR or other volatility indicators
No new bar detection may cause repeated entries on the same bar leading to overtrading
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动性自适应调整止损止盈距离
增加新K线检测逻辑，确保每个信号只在一根K线上触发一次交易，避免重复开仓
加入ADX趋势强度过滤，仅在趋势明确时开仓，减少震荡行情中的无效交易
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism that adaptively adjusts distances based on market volatility
Add new bar detection logic to ensure each signal triggers only one trade per bar, avoiding repeated entries
Add ADX trend strength filter to only open positions when the trend is clear, reducing ineffective trades in ranging markets

risk_points: 固定止损点数在低波动市场中可能过宽造成不必要亏损，在高波动市场中可能过窄导致频繁止损
缺少新K线检测可能导致同一信号重复开仓增加风险敞口
振荡器过滤参数不当可能导致错过有效趋势信号或接受过多假信号
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss pips may be too wide in low-volatility markets causing unnecessary losses, or too narrow in high-volatility markets causing frequent stop-outs
Lack of new bar detection may cause repeated entries on the same signal increasing risk exposure
Improper oscillator filter parameters may lead to missing valid trend signals or accepting too many false signals

summary_en: OzFx is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers combined with oscillator filters to identify and ride market trends. It enters long positions when fast MA crosses above slow MA with confirming oscillator signals, and short positions on the reverse. The EA includes trailing stop functionality and risk management parameters to protect profits during trending moves.
